description: Ministry of Industry & Commerce - Order Under Societies Ordinance that the Societies Known as Women's Association of Sri Lanka Malays, Sheela Suwa Arana, Lanka Pharmaceutical Traders Society Limited Ought to be extended
reasoning: This gazette content involves the Minister of Industry and Commerce exercising powers under the Societies Ordinance (Chapter 123) to authorize purposes for specific societies and limit the application of the Ordinance. This constitutes regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the minister's name and title is incidental to the regulatory function being performed.
